parameters.content:
# Decodo SaaS Pricing Intelligence Workflow (B2B Pricing Radar)
### Demo: Using Decodo's built-in n8n node to pull competitor pricing intelligence
> Crawl any SaaS pricing page, extract plan structures with an LLM, and ship a polished pricing brief to Google Drive + Slack.
## Use cases
- **Product Marketing** validating competitor packaging updates.
- **RevOps** checking for price drift before discount approvals.
- **Leadership** tracking how PLG funnels evolve week to week.

## Flow
1. Manual trigger.
2. Configure target pricing URL + metadata.
3. Decodo node fetches fully rendered HTML (headless JS, device emulation).
4. Code node normalizes HTML to clean text.
5. LLM + structured parser converts text to plan objects.
6. Code node builds KPI-rich pricing brief (markdown).
7. Google Docs + Drive nodes publish a doc + PDF copy.
8. Slack upload shares the PDF to a #pricing-intel channel.

## Requirements
- Decodo API key.
- OpenAI API key (GPT-4.1-mini or similar).
- Google Drive/Docs + Slack credentials.
- Target URL must be public (no auth walls).

### 1. Trigger Workflow
Manual trigger keeps the scrape intentional — ideal when pricing updates are expected (launch days, quarter close, etc.).

### 2. Configure Inputs
Provide the competitor URL, device preference, and report title. This metadata flows into the report & downstream destinations.

### 3. Decodo Pricing Scraper
Runs the official Decodo node to render the entire pricing page (JS + device emulation) so tier cards and popovers are captured.

### 4. Normalize HTML
Custom code removes scripts/styles and leaves only readable text for the LLM to digest reliably.

### 5. Plan Extraction Agent
LLM + structured parser translates messy pricing copy into a predictable JSON schema (plan, price, features, CTA).

### 6. Build SaaS Pricing Brief
Transforms plan JSON into an exec-ready markdown brief with KPIs, tier comparison table, and suggested next steps.

### 7-9. Publish Assets
Set Drive folder → create Google Doc → convert to PDF. Keeps a doc + PDF version for stakeholders.

### 10. Share in Slack
Uploads the PDF straight into the #pricing-intel (or similar) Slack channel for instant distribution.

## Sample brief
Add internal link to the generated Google Doc/PDF after first successful run.
